issues.problem: Contexts 1 and 3 (a plain 'how are you' reply; why we broke up) fit 说来话长 (cy041, same set) just as well.
issues.action: Added a wry sigh to context 1 and replaced context 3 with one about the pain a marriage caused, where only 一言难尽 fits.

issues.problem: Context 6 used it with 记下 (writing a diary), a marginal collocation; the idiom is about telling or reporting.
issues.action: Replaced with relaying what she heard at the hospital to her husband (转告).

issues.problem: English of context 6 was garbled ('no amount of money means you have anything at all').
Context 6 (knowing nothing about one's medicine) could be read as a field of knowledge, where 一窍不通 (cy036) could fit.
issues.action: Made it the facts of a specific matter: unaware of the side effects of a medicine taken for years.

issues.problem: Contexts 2 and 5 (botched the job; management became a mess) fit 乱七八糟 (cy001) equally; one misuse reason was unclear.
issues.action: Rewrote them around bad outcomes (lost the biggest client; results were dreadful) and clarified the reason with the 把……搞得一塌糊涂 pattern.

issues.problem: Misuse 2 (他平时一言不发, of an introvert) is odd rather than clearly wrong to a native speaker.
issues.action: Replaced with a self-contradictory misuse: 一言不发地告诉我 (told me without a word).

issues.problem: All stories are null; none of these idioms has an origin story the reviewer is certain of.
